attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arizona state income tax calculation. Implements flat 2.5% tax structure with standard deductions per AZ tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Arizona Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate AZ tax for Single filer
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.az_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max
result.az_tax_rate mul
/result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Arizona tax calculated (Single): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

result.agi result.az_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max
result.az_tax_rate mul
/result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Arizona tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate AZ tax for Head of Household
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.az_standard_deduction_hoh sub 0 max
result.az_tax_rate mul
/result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Arizona tax calculated (HOH): $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Arizona military retirement income exclusion. Provides 100% exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments. Honors MSRRA (spouse income exempt if different domicile) and SCRA (active duty pay exempt if different state of residence). Per ARS § 43-1022 (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Arizona Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0 /result.az_military_retirement_exclusion xdef 0 /result.az_sbp_exclusion xdef

action_details.action_comment: Apply full exclusion for military retirement pay and SBP payments
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay /result.az_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
taxpayer.sbp_payments 0 gt { taxpayer.sbp_payments /result.az_sbp_exclusion xdef } if
result.az_military_retirement_exclusion result.az_sbp_exclusion add /result.az_total_military_exclusion xdef
result.agi result.az_total_military_exclusion sub 0 max /result.az_adjusted_agi xdef
"Arizona military retirement exclusion: $" result.az_military_retirement_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.az_sbp_exclusion 0 gt { "Arizona SBP exclusion: $" result.az_sbp_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto } if "Arizona total military exclusion: $" result.az_total_military_exclusion cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
